Connect the car and iPhone to the same external Wi-Fi in system settings. Enter its exact name and WPA2 password below; leave the password empty only for an open network. Use WPA2 or WPA2/WPA3 mixed mode and disable client isolation on the router. LPlay keeps this Wi-Fi connection and creates no hotspot.
